summary: Comprehensive, professionally-structured test suite with strong end-to-end coverage via act. Unit tests cover all module functions with good error scenarios and exact output validation. Workflow tests validate YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and execution through Docker. Minor gaps: edge cases like malformed field values, missing fixture files, and tests appearing/disappearing across matrix runs untested. Act tests are somewhat brittle (regex-based output matching). Fixtures are well-designed inline hashtables with proper isolation and cleanup. Good separation of workflow tests (outside act) from unit tests (inside act) to avoid act-in-act. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality.
